segments.text: Ok so this is the Tool-based generative UI page for Google ADK with Vue, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, it says CopilotKit renders your component when the agent calls the tool, but no agent side is shown.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. I asked for the Paris weather, it should render the weather card, but the agent just types a text card.
So again the agent needs the AGUI toolset, the page never mentions it, so the card never renders.
So this needs a fix, kindly check it.
